text: An update from the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, on maintaining the status of Campbell's Soup Company site as part of the South Etobicoke Employment Lands.

The Toronto Film, Television, and Digital Media Board: 1. In recognizing the value of maintaining the zoning of the lands currently occupied by the Campbell's Soup Company in South Etobicoke as Employment Lands, requested the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture to ensure that the Toronto Film, Television, and Digital Media Board be advised of any rezoning applications.
